class.name: MaszynaTurntableServer
class.description: A turntable is a [code]turn[/code] or [code]table[/code] track of a scenery ([code]TTrack[/code] of [code]tt_Table[/code]) bound to the model of its name, which an [code]animation[/code] event turns. A [code]switch 1[/code] unlocks it: it is taken off its neighbours, no traffic is let on it, and its track follows the model's first animated submodel from then on. A [code]switch 0[/code] locks it where it stands, joins it to the tracks its ends meet and lets traffic on again ([code]TTrack::Switch()[/code], [code]Track.cpp:1787-1833[/code]; [code]TTrack::RaAnimate()[/code], [code]Track.cpp:2024-2061[/code]). The track's shape, its neighbours and its speed limit are [TrackServer]'s; this server only says what they become.

method.name: turntable_create
method.description: A turntable of [param track], locked, as it is loaded.

method.name: turntable_is_locked
method.description: Whether [param turntable] is locked - not turning, its track joined where it stands.

method.name: turntable_lock
method.description: [code]switch 0[/code] ([code]Track.cpp:1807-1831[/code]): its track laid where the model turned it to and joined to the tracks its ends meet ([method TrackServer.track_connect]) - and, if it met any, traffic let on at 6 km/h, on the tracks it joined that were stopped as well, and its [code]:joined[/code] event run.

method.name: turntable_set_joined_event
method.description: The event run when [param turntable] is locked and joined ([code]<track>:joined[/code], [code]Track.cpp:3418[/code]).

method.name: turntable_set_model
method.description: The model of the track's name [param turntable] is bound to, and its submodel the track follows: the model's first animated submodel ([code]TAnimModel::GetContainer()[/code], [code]AnimModel.cpp:486-489[/code]). A turntable of no model does not turn.

method.name: turntable_unlock
method.description: [code]switch 1[/code] ([code]Track.cpp:1789-1806[/code]): its track taken off its neighbours ([method TrackServer.track_disconnect]), no traffic let on it, and following the model's submodel on every simulation step until it is locked.
